context: Lae'zel is confronting a terrified tiefling (Zorru) who claims to have seen another githyanki; she’s trying to pry that information out of him by sheer intimidation. She insists he perform a Crèche K'liir greeting — bowing and then lowering his head — as a test of deference, speaking and acting with arrogant, fearsome certainty. Zorru is afraid and babbles pleas, even half‑heartedly raising a weapon, but clearly cowers under her presence; cinematic direction emphasizes Lae'zel looming over him. The player may interrupt to restrain Lae'zel or to order Zorru to comply; earlier cluster context also places this encounter amid tensions where Lae'zel was previously discovered captive and tieflings debated what to do with her.
